title: Winter wheat varieties, lutos, no irrigation, Transylvanian plateau
rationale: Recommended zones are the whole lever here. Only Ursita and Voinic are listed for 'toate zonele de cultură a grâului din România'; Glosa is sud/vest/est, Izvor is sud/est plus 'zone cu frecvență mare a secetei', and Otilia is vest/Câmpia Română/Dobrogea/Moldova. None of those three names Transylvania, and Turda is on the Transylvanian plateau, so one of the two all-zone varieties must rank first and each must outrank a zone-restricted one. Drought tolerance cannot break the tie — all five are ridicata — and Turda is the wettest captured site (674 mm annual normal, 1 drought year in 10), so the dryland profile adds nothing.
